chunks: As for their adherence to what was narrated,

“Adhere to the first until the next one is established for you…” is a single hadith (khabar wahid). And with this, Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah interpreted it with an interpretation that is close [to the truth].

key_terms.خَبَرٌ وَاحِدٌ: Single hadith (a narration from a single chain, not necessarily mutawatir)

ai.seo_question: What is the evidentiary status of the narration 'Adhere to the first until the next one is established' and how did Sa'd ibn Abdullah interpret it?
ai.summary: This passage highlights the scholarly rigor of the Shia tradition by demonstrating that even a single narration (khabar wahid) can serve as valid proof if interpreted correctly. It specifically cites Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah al-Qummi, a key figure in the transmission of hadith, who provided a close and acceptable interpretation (ta'wil) to validate the narration's authority regarding the Imamate of Imam Hasan al-Askari (a.s).
